identified_as: Karns City Area Junior/Senior High School, Karns City
wikipedia: Karns City Area Junior/Senior High School
notes: Purple and gold attested in 1953 and today; district site found at kcasdk12.org.
evidence: District site kcasdk12.org theme CSS: purple #391379 (most used), gold #976D11. District KC oval logo (looked at): beveled purple letters #32275C with pale metallic gold #DACFAE outline on white; flat site theme hexes used since logo is shaded. 1953 Afterthought yearbook OCR: cheerleaders in purple skirts, gold sweaters.

era: Area later part of Northwestern SD (red and black).
evidence: West Springfield Laurel yearbooks 1951, 1954, 1955, 1957, 1958 (all years on e-yearbook) full OCR re-grepped for colour words, uniforms, sweaters: only class colours (blue/white 1957, mint green/white 1958) and store ads; no school colours. WebSearch found nothing for the Erie County school.

era: Later part of Northwestern SD (also red and black).
notes: Red and black from Albion's own 1945 yearbook; same pair as successor Northwestern, but attested before the merger.
evidence: Albion Alhi 1945 yearbook OCR, football report: "The Red and Black gridders opened on Labor Day ... playing Union City" (Red and Black named twice). 1948 and 1951-58 books state no school colours; 1958 notes contest to choose colours for new Northwestern HS. No image with clean colour, so no hex.

identified_as: Washington Township High School, Apollo (Westmoreland County)
era: Township later part of Kiski Area SD (Cavaliers); Kiski colours not used here.
notes: Identity now fairly firm: the project's 1959-60 data put Washington Township in District 7 Section 2 with Kittanning, Greensburg, Latrobe, Hempfield, Norwin, Jeannette (Westmoreland/Armstrong), which fits the Apollo-area school, not Waynesboro (maroon/gray). Crimson and white from its own yearbooks; 1951/1954 band uniforms maroon, so the red may be a dark crimson.
evidence: Washington Twp HS (Apollo) Washtonian yearbook OCR: 1952 "The Crimson and White Eleven", "1951 Crimson and White Football Squad", majorettes in "Crimson and White uniforms"; 1954 cheerleaders "flashes of crimson and white" but band in "maroon and grey uniforms"; 1951 majorettes "maroon and white". School paper also called Crimson and White. Identity cross-checked against repo files overtime/lower/1959-section.json and 1960-section.json (D7_S2 opponents). No clean image, so no hex.

identified_as: New Kensington High School, New Kensington
era: Merged with Arnold in 1965; became Valley HS (Vikings, black and gold) c. 1967.
notes: Corrected: school colours read as red and black (teams called "the Red and Black" 1945-49); white appears in band/cheer uniforms (1947-48, 1956-57), so kept as a third colour.
evidence: Taleoken yearbook OCR, 15 years scanned (1944-59): football reports call the team "the Red and Black" (1945, 1946 "Red and Black grid machine", 1949 "the Red and Black's record"); 1945 band and teams in "red and black uniforms"; 1958 "Red and black day"; band "red and white uniforms" 1947, cheerleaders "red and white outfits" 1948, red sweaters/white skirts 1956-57. No clean image, so no hex.

era: Predecessor of Cameron County HS (Red Raiders, also red and white).
notes: Red and white confirmed from Emporium's own alma mater and cheer uniforms (1940s), not inferred from the successor.
evidence: Emporium Raider yearbook OCR: alma mater printed 1943, 1945, 1946 begins "Red and White, we sing our praise to you" and ends "Our Alma Mater hail all hail / The Red and White"; 1945 cheerleaders "in their flashy red and white uniforms"; football team "the Red Raiders". No clean image, so no hex.

identified_as: Lock Haven Senior High School, Lock Haven (Clinton County)
era: Closed 1999/2000; merged with Bald Eagle-Nittany into Central Mountain HS (royal blue/white).
notes: Purple and white, Bobcats, from the school's own Gazette yearbooks 1934-55. Not Lock Haven University's crimson.
evidence: Lock Haven HS Gazette yearbook OCR (15 years, 1934-55): 1934 alma mater ends "We'll hail thee ever, dear Purple and White"; football/basketball reports call teams "the Purple and White eleven", "Purple and White Bobcats" (1936), "Purple and White Band" (1937); "purple and white" in 1934-41, 1947-48; "purple" heavily used through 1955. No clean image, so no hex.

MaxPreps team page (earlier pass) lists color1 #8F0018 (maroon), color2 #C8880A (gold), color3 #FFFFFF; agrees with district Wikipedia infobox "Maroon and Gold" (re-checked). Hex left null: district sites chbucs.org (403), chsdschools.org (403), chartiers-houston.org and k12.pa.us guesses unreachable; MaxPreps 403 this pass and Wikipedia has no logo image, so no logo or school-site pixels were seen.

era: Merged c. 1959 into Canon-McMillan (blue and gold, Big Macs); Canon-McMillan colours not used here.
notes: Brown and gold from Canonsburg's own Canon Log yearbooks (1940-55).
evidence: Canonsburg HS Canon Log yearbook OCR (15 years, 1923-55): 1940 basketball "a determined Brown and Gold squad ... enabled the Gunners"; 1949 "the 1949 Brown and Gold Band", flag twirlers in "brown and gold outfits", majorettes white and gold, cheerleaders all-white or brown-and-white; 1950 alma mater text "Colors of Brown and Gold stand as a symbol"; 1955 ushers in brown skirts and "gold colored school sweaters" (majorettes red and white that year). No clean image, so no hex.
